instructions.question: What overall polarity does this French tweet convey about the situation, event or topic it reports (often ecology, energy, climate), reading its wording at face value?
instructions.rule: Judge the polarity of the reported outcome, not only the author's tone: headlines about progress, solutions, funding, launches, protection, awards or support are positive even when phrased neutrally; headlines about threats, damage, deaths, decline, suspension, controversy, opposition or failure are negative. Sarcasm is read literally: praise words (bravo, stimule, prix, merci) make it positive, attack words make it negative. Use neutral for puns and banter with no real event, personal anecdotes, explanations or statistics without a good/bad outcome, and plain agenda or meeting notices.

neutral.what: Information with no clear good or bad outcome: agendas, meetings, descriptive facts, statistics, playful wordplay, chit-chat.
examples: L'Ademe publie l'édition 2014 des chiffres-clés des #déchets (Ademe publishes the 2014 key figures on waste)
"On peut vendre du vent, regarde les éoliennes" (You can sell wind, look at wind turbines)
@user Je leur donne le sein, c'est plus écologique ! (I breastfeed them, it's more ecological!)
neutral.cues: publie (publishes), réunion (meeting), sera l'invitée (will be the guest), infographie, chiffres (figures), lol, puns on vent (wind)
neutral.not_for: News announcing clear progress (positive) or harm/suspension (negative).

positive.what: Progress, innovations, investments, launches, protections, approvals, celebrations, advocacy for solutions, or literal praise (including ironic praise).
examples: Areva : Les 80 éoliennes du parc de Global Tech I installées avec succès http (Areva: the 80 turbines of the Global Tech I park successfully installed)
#ecologie Rénovation énergétique : des aides renforcées depuis le 1er septembre http (Energy renovation: reinforced subsidies since 1 September)
Au Testet, la police stimule la croissance en coupant les arbres (At Testet, police stimulate growth by cutting trees)
positive.cues: avec succès (successfully), lance (launches), inauguration, soutenue (supported), renforcées (reinforced), mise sur (bets on), bravo, merci, lauréat (winner), à l'honneur (honoured), :D
positive.not_for: Puns, personal anecdotes and plain explanatory content with no outcome are neutral.

negative.what: Threats, damage, deaths, decline, suspensions, scandals, opposition, criticism, anger or insults.
examples: Le manchot empereur victime du réchauffement climatique http (The emperor penguin, victim of global warming)
Suspension sine die de l'#ecotaxe http (Indefinite suspension of the ecotax)
@user Les éoliennes défigurent nos jolies campagnes. (Wind turbines disfigure our countryside.)
negative.cues: menacée (threatened), victime (victim), péril, suspension, scandale, enfer (hell), opposition, craintes (fears), détruit (destroyed), inutile (useless)
negative.not_for: Ironic praise phrased positively is positive; harmless jokes are neutral.
